source: docs/research/annotator-landmarks/README.md: the owner's local session of 1 November 2026; counts read on the grid that night (listings and the read-only CPU job 40940203)

notation.qaloop:<name>: one of the 18 points of tools/qaloop_gates.py LANDMARKS, as grid/autoanatomist/autoanatomist/oracle.py places it
notation.engine:<module.function>: a construction of the vendored morphometry engine, grid/bordercall/morphometry
notation.fixed: one place on the bone, the same in every view
notation.silhouette: where the bone's outline turns in the view read; a fixed 3-D point stands for it only near that view
notation.held: the path under the grid's data root, or false

schemes.name: DeepFluoro's fourteen pelvic landmarks
schemes.citation: Grupp RB, Unberath M, Gao C, et al. Automatic annotation of hip anatomy in fluoroscopy for robust and efficient 2D/3D registration. Int J Comput Assist Radiol Surg 2020;15(5):759-769. doi:10.1007/s11548-020-02162-7 (PMC7263976)
schemes.view: any C-arm pose (the arm's frames all within 15 degrees of anteroposterior)

landmarks.name: FH-l, FH-r
landmarks.definition: centers of the femoral head
landmarks.counterpart_3d: engine:pelvis.socket_centre (acetabular sphere; a sphere on the femoral head's own mask is the direct one)

landmarks.name: GSN-l, GSN-r
landmarks.definition: greater sciatic notches
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the notch's deepest point on the ilium's posterior border

landmarks.name: IOF-l, IOF-r
landmarks.definition: inferior obturator foramen
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the obturator foramen's lowest rim point

landmarks.name: MOF-l, MOF-r
landmarks.definition: medial obturator foramen
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the obturator foramen's most medial rim point

landmarks.name: SPS-l, SPS-r
landmarks.definition: superior pubis symphysis
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the symphysis's upper end on each pubis

landmarks.name: IPS-l, IPS-r
landmarks.definition: inferior pubis symphysis
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the symphysis's lower end on each pubis

landmarks.name: ASIS-l, ASIS-r
landmarks.definition: anterior superior iliac spine
landmarks.counterpart_3d: new: the spine's most anterior point (engine:pelvis.crest_top is the crest's top, not ASIS)

datasets.name: DeepFluoro release (ipcai_2020_full_res_data.h5)
datasets.format: HDF5: <specimen>/vol-landmarks/<name> 3-vector, world frame LPS; <specimen>/projections/<frame>/gt-landmarks/<name> 2-vector in pixels
datasets.note: 70 3-D points and 3,668 2-D entries over the five specimens the arm may read (262 frames; every frame lists all fourteen); the held-out specimen 18-1109 was not opened
